checks.text: The page shows the heading "Meal Planner" and the tab labels "Week View" and "Shopping List".

Clicking the button "Add Meal" opens a form. Filling the field labelled "Meal Name" with "Pasta", the field labelled "Day" with "Monday", and the field labelled "Ingredients" with "Spaghetti, Tomato sauce", then clicking "Save" adds a row to the week view containing "Pasta" and "Monday".
After adding "Pasta" on Monday with ingredients "Spaghetti, Tomato sauce", clicking the tab "Shopping List" shows a list item containing "Spaghetti" and a list item containing "Tomato sauce".
Adding a second meal "Salad" on Tuesday with ingredients "Lettuce, Tomato sauce" causes the "Shopping List" tab to show "Tomato sauce" only once, with a quantity of 2.
In the "Week View" tab, clicking the button "Delete Pasta" removes the "Pasta" row. The "Shopping List" tab no longer shows "Spaghetti", but still shows "Tomato sauce" with a quantity of 1.
In the "Shopping List" tab, clicking the button "Copy List" copies the text "Spaghetti: 1\nTomato sauce: 1" to the clipboard.
In the "Week View" tab, clicking the button "Export ICS" downloads a file named "meal-plan.ics" containing the text "SUMMARY:Pasta".
With no meals added, the "Week View" tab shows the text "No meals planned" and the "Shopping List" tab shows the text "No items to buy".
Reload keeps the meal "Pasta" on Monday; the "Week View" tab still shows the row containing "Pasta" and "Monday".
